routes.finding: The official portal exposes TJAP and Turma Recursal súmulas, not a searchable general collection of second-degree decisions.
The legacy portal search links to Tucujuris jurisprudence but does not expose a decision result or document contract.
The official Diário da Justiça entry is not publicly retrievable from this bounded request; no retry or bypass was attempted.

decision: These official repositories do not provide a reproducible public general CJSG search without the Tucujuris security boundary. Súmulas remain a separate specialized source and must not be promoted as general CJSG.
